priorities.title: Clarify the first playable session
priorities.subject: gameplay
acceptance_criteria: A new player can identify how to drop a ball and open the first gate without reading the README.
Required controls are visible without expanding optional controls.
The main interaction remains usable at 1440 by 900.

priorities.title: Improve route and interaction readability
priorities.subject: design
acceptance_criteria: Entry, route direction, damage gates, upgrades, and finish are visually distinct during play.
Labels remain readable against the scene from the default camera.

priorities.title: Define progression and replay goals
priorities.subject: gameplay_systems
acceptance_criteria: Spawn rate, ball value, and ball damage upgrades create distinct useful choices.
The interface communicates the next meaningful goal and its cost.
Randomizing the route does not erase earned progression unless the PRD explicitly requires it.
